description: Register a QuestDB HTTP REST API resource for use by other components

host_url.label: Host URL
host_url.description: Base URL of the QuestDB HTTP REST API, e.g. 'http://questdb:9000'.

username.label: Username
username.description: HTTP basic auth username, if QuestDB's built-in auth is enabled.

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Env var holding the basic auth password.

request_headers.label: Request Headers
request_headers.description: Extra HTTP headers, e.g. a bearer token if QuestDB sits behind an authenticating proxy.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

name: QuestDB Resource
